tuit.text: Grand Forks AFB soon to be known as America's Global Hawk Base once the @319ABW is re-designated as the 319th Reconnaissance Wing, June 28. The re-designation aligns the host wing & the 69th Reconnaissance Group, which flies the RQ-4 #GlobalHawk. (#USAF/SSgt Michael Reeves Jr.) https://t.co/UV3O7zAXwh
